# Vendored browser dependency

`supabase-js-2.111.0.min.js` is the official UMD browser bundle for
`@supabase/supabase-js` version `2.111.0`, downloaded from:

`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.111.0/dist/umd/supabase.min.js`

SHA-256: `0c2562701c7ac6da5f79607f1e001c5d7fa1a56a591cf383996c4212267a925d`

It is vendored so authentication can initialize from the cached app shell without a runtime CDN
dependency. The package is MIT licensed; the upstream license is included as `LICENSE`.
